Hey , I am  Dr.Neha Singh (PT) and welcome back my channel 'Believe ~In therapy '

I made this channel  about anything that interess me and helps you guys ,so let's learn and grow together .........📚📚
Be want to be motivated and confident everytime ....

In this channel you will find informative videos about physiotherapy ....my goal to make physiotherapy more popular and to  make people aware about physiotherapy,.. .
My main focus to be on Academic and clinical 
My best wishes is with you .
............................
........
Please ...like 👍share , comments and subscribe to my channel ..

Thankyou 
......
Keep supporting me 😊
